title: Security advisory and live deployment scope
provenance: Illustrative synthetic example; not an independently validated benchmark

decisions.question: Which record determines the artifact actually running in each environment?
candidate_paths: Use signed deployment audit and digest
decisions.decisive_evidence: Signed deployment audit supersedes stale release tags

decisions.question: Which live artifacts contain the advisory-matched version?
candidate_paths: Match dependency version for running digests
decisions.decisive_evidence: Release-specific dependency manifest and advisory version range

decisions.question: Which candidate environments are actually reachable through untrusted ingress?
decisions.decisive_evidence: Runtime call graph and ingress routing

decisions.question: Is rollback compatible with the deployed schema migration?
decisions.decisive_evidence: Irreversible schema migration documented for current database

decisions.question: Which verification targets are required for the actual chosen mitigation?
candidate_paths: Validate every changed deployment and invariant
decisions.decisive_evidence: Deployed digest audit and verified mitigation scope
decisions.intended_state: Verify patched web-prod and canary; leave other services unchanged

edges.reason: Running digest determines which dependency manifest applies
Only advisory-matched binaries enter reachability analysis
Exposed environment population defines applicable mitigation scope
Forward-patch choice changes required verification tests
